In \cref{tab:e2}, the in-band instances are the 256 validation instances, with $l_c$ from 0.0579 to 0.0906, and the fine-mesh instances 256 instances at $l_c = 0.0374$, never trained on. A step time is that of one label-free training step on one instance of the stated size, on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 with TF32, from a dedicated benchmark whose instances at the two ends of the in-band range have 12,318 and 3,774 nodes and whose fine-mesh instance has 41,367: for the bottleneck the median over three repetitions of the time of 110 steps minus that of 10 steps, divided by 100, which removes the set-up time; for the transformer a single timed step, its set-up included, the mean of its two benchmark measurements, 1,408 and 1,422 ms in-band and 14,793 and 14,798 ms on the fine mesh. The noise guard of the bottleneck run's criteria (\cref{tab:criteria}) is that of the paper's \ref{app:claims}, with the label-free transformer as the reference; the pre-registration calls it the resolution.
